name: Mac Self-Heal — typed wrapper for chuck-mac-self-heal.mjs
description: Typed surface for the chuck-mac-self-heal stewardship script. Three subprocess actions: status (read disk/swap/loadavg/uptime + last-receipt summary), plan (enumerate reversible actions, --allow-cloud-offload widens to evidence offload), apply (execute up to --max-actions with --only-under-pressure / --cloud-target / --allow-cloud-offload gating). Used by skill-health-steward (stabilize + apply paths), skill-docket-executor, and skill-self-improvement-scanner. Full TS port deferred until openclaw daemon support lands.

scriptPath.label: chuck-mac-self-heal.mjs path
scriptPath.help: Path to the canonical .mjs implementation. Defaults to the repo's extensions/memory-graph/scripts/chuck-mac-self-heal.mjs.
